title: ZIET AawasSetu Provisional Room Allotment
rules: Same-school grouping where feasible, followed by same-region grouping.
Resource Persons receive separate single rooms where available.
Women participants receive preference in A1; this is not a restriction.
Differently abled and senior participants receive ground-floor priority when verified.
A1 Ground Floor Room 1 is Store Room cum Guard Room and is not allotable.
All payments must be made at the ZIET Office only.
